## Findings

- **story_code_conflict**: C-1 says an admin creates a tag, but the tags_create spec only requires an authenticated caller (any of the three auth schemes). No admin or superuser restriction is documented, although run_task documents 'Superuser only' elsewhere. (openapi/api/tags/POST.yaml:18, openapi/api/tasks/run/POST.yaml:3)
- **missing_error_path**: Duplicate tag names on create are not covered by the requirements, and the TagRequest schema has no uniqueness constraint or 400 response documented. (openapi/api/tags/POST.yaml:22, openapi/components.yaml:5489)
- **missing_error_path**: Create documents only a 201 response. Validation failures (missing name, name over 128 characters) and unauthenticated calls have no documented 400 or 401/403 response. (openapi/api/tags/POST.yaml:22, openapi/components.yaml:5522)
- **missing_error_path**: Retrieve and destroy document only success responses. The 404 required by C-5 is not in the spec, so the not-found behaviour is only implied by framework defaults. (openapi/api/tags/{id}/GET.yaml:21, openapi/api/tags/{id}/DELETE.yaml:17)
- **missing_error_path**: Deleting a tag that has documents attached or child tags is not covered. The Tag schema exposes parent and children, but no rule says what happens to them on delete. (openapi/api/tags/{id}/DELETE.yaml:17, openapi/components.yaml:5460, openapi/components.yaml:5463)
- **suspected_defect**: The page_size query parameter on the tag list has no maximum. A single request can ask for an unbounded number of tags. (openapi/api/tags/GET.yaml:50, openapi/api/tags/GET.yaml:55)
- **rule_interaction**: Paging with no default ordering: the list has an ordering parameter but no default sort, so page boundaries between requests are not guaranteed stable when tags are created or deleted. (openapi/api/tags/GET.yaml:43, openapi/api/tags/GET.yaml:49)
- **missing_error_path**: Anonymous access to tag routes is only implied by the security list. The requirements do not state that anonymous callers are rejected, and no 401 is documented. (openapi/api/tags/GET.yaml:63, openapi/api/tags/{id}/GET.yaml:17)

## Decisions

- intended behaviour: page_size capped at a documented maximum such as 100, with larger values clamped or rejected with 400 (assumed)
- admin-only create: admin or superuser only, ordinary user gets 403 (assumed)
- duplicate tag names: reject with 400 or 409 (assumed)
- delete tag in use or with children: refuse with 409 (assumed)
- page_size maximum: cap at a documented maximum such as 100 (assumed)
- default ordering of the list: Sort by name ascending (assumed)
